senses.gloss: (a corrupt. for tabula or tabella,—ae) letter, despatch. Ab. d’R. Nath. ch. IV [read:] עד שבאה אליו ד׳ וכ׳ when he received a letter from Rome announcing the death of the Emperor &c.; (Ed. Schechter 2ⁿᵈ vers. ch. VI: באו לו אגרות). Meg. Taan. ch. XII עד שבאת עליו דיופלה של רומי ופצעו וכ׳ when a despatch arrived against him, and his head was split with clubs (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Fustuarium); Koh. R. to III, 17; Taan. 18ᵇ דאפלי מרומי Ms. M. (ed. דיופלי מהעיר); Sifra Emor Par. 8, ch. IX.
